blocks.heading: Paid Ads & GEO Targeting that *Maximise Your ROI*
blocks.lead: Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ads managed for maximum return. Precise audience targeting, compelling creative, and relentless optimisation — every rupee accountable, every campaign scalable.

header.title: Every paid channel, *fully optimised*
header.subtitle: From search intent to social discovery — we run campaigns that reach the right people at the right moment.

items.title: Google Search Ads
items.body: High-intent keyword campaigns with smart bidding, ad copy testing, and Quality Score optimisation to capture buyers actively searching for you.

items.title: Meta Ads (FB & IG)
items.body: Audience-driven social campaigns with creative testing, lookalike audiences, and funnel-stage targeting to turn scrollers into customers.

items.title: LinkedIn Ads
items.body: B2B targeting by job title, company size, industry, and seniority — ideal for enterprise software, consulting, and professional services.

items.title: YouTube Ads
items.body: Video ad campaigns for brand awareness and retargeting — skippable, non-skippable, and bumper ads optimised for view-through conversions.

items.title: GEO Targeting
items.body: Hyper-local campaigns by city, postcode, or radius around your location — perfect for retail, hospitality, clinics, and local services.

items.title: Retargeting
items.body: Re-engage website visitors, abandoned cart users, and warm audiences with precision retargeting that converts consideration into purchase.

header.title: How we make *every rupee work*
header.subtitle: No set-and-forget campaigns. We monitor, test, and optimise continuously.

items.title: Account Audit
items.body: We analyse existing campaigns — identifying wasted spend, missed audiences, and quick wins that can improve performance immediately.

items.title: Strategy & Creative
items.body: Audience research, campaign structure planning, ad copy writing, and creative briefing — all aligned to your specific conversion goals.

items.title: Launch & Optimise
items.body: Campaigns launched with A/B testing baked in from day one. Bid adjustments, negative keywords, and creative swaps based on live data.

items.title: Weekly Reporting
items.body: Clear weekly performance reports with impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA, and ROAS — no jargon, just the numbers that matter.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.body: Organic growth to complement paid ads

items.title: Analytics & Dashboards
items.body: Track ROAS and CPA in real time

items.title: Web Development
items.body: High-converting landing pages for your ads
